case.title: A location with no technicians shows only Unassigned in Tech View and Board View
case.custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit.
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.
  • Location {Location-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Empty Shop") is used by this case only and has no technicians: no staff member has {Location-A} in their Location field. You are working at {Location-A}.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST F2 No Tech Location") has two Approved work orders at {Location-A}, {Work-order-1} and {Work-order-2} (for example S10043-17831 and S10043-17832), with no lead technician.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is ticked in Status, Asset on Site shows no choice (if its chip shows Yes or No, click the x on the chip), Assigned to me is off and Search is empty.
case.custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders and click the All tab.
  2. Click Tech View in the display switcher.
  3. Read what the page shows.
  4. Click Board View in the display switcher.
  5. Read what the page shows.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: Tech View shows the Unassigned group holding {Work-order-1} and {Work-order-2}, and no technician groups.
  • Step 5: Board View shows the Unassigned column holding {Work-order-1} and {Work-order-2}, and no technician columns.
  • Steps 3 and 5: below Unassigned, both displays show the person icon, "No technicians yet", then "Add technicians to assign work orders. Until then, every work order stays in Unassigned.", with an "Add Technician" button.

Source — where this behaviour comes from

Epic SV-10043; story SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View — table grouped by lead technician); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 54 (15 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), Design updates required from Branko, S2-R2 and S3-R1, read 15 Oct 2026. The Design updates line was reworded in version 43 (8 Oct 2026); the no-technicians state is still listed as design work, so the expected results are unchanged. Claude Design export of 14 Oct 2026 (Work Orders.dc.html), no-technicians empty state. PRD footer comment Slavcho Mitrov 1 Oct 2026 item 3 (the panel explains work stays in Unassigned, no Add Technician button). Source-verified 15 October 2026. Last checked against build v26.43.2-f8698cb (QA branch sv11555) on 10/28/2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-N1d (PRD version 81, 27 Oct 2026, read 28 Oct 2026; Chris Ward on SV-11555, 27 Oct 2026): “When the location has no technicians and the open tab has work orders, Tech View and Board View show only Unassigned, followed by the design’s state: the user-round icon, “No technicians yet”, then “Add technicians to assign work orders. Until then, every work order stays in Unassigned.”, with an Add Technician button. When the location has no technicians and the open tab has no work orders, the state reads “Nothing here yet”, then “Add technicians and create your first work order to track work by tech.”, with the Create Work Order button of S1-N1c and the Add Technician button. Both states are judged on the open tab, as S1-N1c and List view are: a location with work orders on other tabs still reads “Nothing here yet” on an empty tab. Add Technician opens Settings → Staff, the page where staff are added, and shows only to users with 'Settings → App', the permission that opens that page. When the Technician Toggle feature ships, its S3-R10 replaces this state's text and makes the button read "Set Up Technicians" and open Roles & Permissions ( Technician Toggle PRD ).”
  • Design updates required from Branko: “Filtered-empty results (the List's empty state, S1-N1), and an organization with no technicians, in both new views.”
  • S2-R2: “Keep Unassigned, containing work orders without a lead technician, fixed before all technician groups.”
  • S3-R1: “Show one Board View column per eligible technician under S2-R7, plus Unassigned.”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, no-technicians empty state: “Add technicians to assign work orders. Until then, every work order stays in Unassigned.”
